data.text: Virtual means something that is there in essence or effect but not in fact, while reality is something that exists independently of ideas. Virtual reality is an artificial environment provided by a computer through sensory stimuli, in which a person's actions partially determine what happens in the environment.
points: Virtual means something that is there in essence or effect but not in fact.
Reality is something that exists independently of ideas.
Virtual reality is a computer-provided artificial environment where user actions partially determine what happens.

data.text: A virtual reality system is defined by an artificial environment, sensory experience, and user interaction. The artificial environment is a computer-generated representation of a real or imaginary world. Sensory experience involves computer-generated stimuli for immersion, while user interaction allows users to interact with elements to produce dynamic changes.
points: A virtual reality system is defined by an artificial environment, sensory experience, and user interaction.
An artificial environment is a computer-generated representation of a real or imaginary world.
Sensory experience involves computer-generated stimuli to provide an immersive experience.
User interaction allows users to act on elements to produce dynamic changes in the environment.

data.text: A system is a virtual reality (VR) system if it satisfies three characteristics: a virtual environment, an immersive experience, and interaction. CAD, video conferencing, and 3D movies are not VR systems because they each fail to meet at least one of these three requirements.
points: A system is a virtual reality (VR) system if it satisfies three characteristics: a virtual environment, an immersive experience, and interaction.
CAD, video conferencing, and 3D movies are not VR systems because they each fail to meet at least one of these three characteristics.
